name: Ruy Barbosa
contribution: A Brazilian politician, writer, jurist, philologist, journalist and diplomat.
legacy: A prominent defender of civil liberties who called for the abolition of slavery in Brazil, this person represented Brazil in the second Hague convention, and argued for Brazil's participation in World War I on the side of the Allies.

checks.lead: Ruy Barbosa de Oliveira (5 November 1849 – 1 March 1923), also known as Rui Barbosa, was a Brazilian  politician, writer, jurist, philologist, journalist and diplomat.
